name: Finch
description: A nervous courier with tired eyes and a coat that has seen too much rain.
dialogue: Finch glances over his shoulder. "Keep your voice down. People listen in places like this."

name: Viola "Marches" Marchenko
description: A sharp-eyed fixer with a calm voice and a reputation for knowing who owes what.
dialogue: "Information has a cost," Marches says. "Question is whether you're paying in eddies, favours, or blood."
